publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.1.3 uses rer 0.2.2 package mode, sharing the CLI and deployment kit from the published package. It adds first-run monitor proposals, previewable monitor-definition imports with undo, and owner-confirmed alert drills, and fixes dialog focus return and runner-key labelling. Local development opens signed in through the private development gate. Recovery preserves deployment migration history and validates its hashes and completion state before transfer; restored monitors are paused, destinations disabled and notification work inactive. Unbound CLI archives from Uptime 0.1.2 and earlier require re-export from the upgraded source installation. Archive validation includes projected capacity checks and atomic refusal when the receiving installation changes during restore. Accessibility evaluation is headless and does not assess spoken announcements or certify WCAG conformance. Local evidence does not establish hosted operation or recipient acceptance.
